name: codebase-index
description: Semantic code search and codebase graph tools for Claude Code

args: if [ "$OS" = Windows_NT ]; then echo "codebase-index: this plugin's launcher does not support Windows; register open-codebase-index-mcp directly in the host's MCP settings (docs/installation.md)" >&2; exit 1; fi; if command -v ocbi-mcp >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec ocbi-mcp "$@"; fi; exec npx -y --package 'https://github.com/filip-gooddata/open-codebase-index/releases/download/v0.38.2-gd.9/open-codebase-index-0.38.2-gd.9.tgz' open-codebase-index-mcp "$@"
